taxonomic_history.name: Hypocryphalus dilutus
taxonomic_history.note: Johnson et al. (2017) used Hypocryphalus dilutus (Eichhoff, 1878a), stat. rev., and treated Cryphalus dilutus Eichhoff, 1878b: 490 as a new synonym. Following the generic synonymy of Hypocryphalus with Cryphalus (Johnson et al., 2020), this is a historical combination of the accepted species, not a separate species-level synonym.

nomenclature_note: Johnson et al. (2017) used Hypocryphalus dilutus (Eichhoff, 1878a) as a reinstated valid species and synonymized Cryphalus dilutus Eichhoff, 1878b: 490. The 2017 genus placement is recorded as a historical combination, not an additional species-level synonym. The 1878a accepted name and 1878b synonym are retained.
